R261.note: Ownership check before deleteById closes the IDOR, but a non-owned document returns 403 rather than the existing not-found path, revealing existence contrary to the stated contract.

R262.note: Tika.detect(byte[]) sniffs magic bytes independent of the client-chosen suffix; storage path, UUID naming and responses unchanged, new dependency stated.

R263.note: Positional bind placeholders with the bind array remove the values from the SQL text; result shape and options otherwise unchanged.

R264.note: RESP multibulk encoding length-prefixes every argument so CRLF/whitespace in session_id or locale cannot split arguments or inject commands; same HSET semantics and return value.

R265.note: Length is now bounded by receivedByteCount - 2 after the existing >= 2 check, so memmove cannot read past the received data or the array; valid messages behave as before.

R266.note: Dropping cmd.exe /c for an argument array and absolute PING.EXE path closes the shell injection, but the added host/count character allowlists (stated) can reject inputs the original accepted, e.g. underscore hostnames, IPv6 zone IDs or counts over 9999.

R267.note: Removing the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping; the review text is still rendered, and the loss of raw-HTML rendering is stated with a sanitizer path for rich text.

R268.note: realpath plus commonpath containment closes both absolute and ../ traversal, but the added rejection of any separator (stated) also refuses subdirectory paths such as 2024/q3.pdf that the original served from under BASE_DIR.

R269.note: session_regenerate_id() immediately after credential verification and before session writes closes fixation; no other logic or return value changed.

R270.note: Decoding into a jobWire DTO without IsAdmin keeps the gob format (extra stream fields are ignored) and the server sets IsAdmin itself, matching the contract; Command and Priority still flow to runJob.

R271.note: PasswordEncoder.matches against the stored hash now gates the token; the switch to BadCredentialsException, null-hash rejection and dummy-hash timing equalisation are all stated and block no valid login.

R272.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) bounds the write; the [TRUNCATED] marker and 1/-2 return values only apply where the original invoked undefined behaviour and are stated plainly.

R273.note: GetFullPath containment with a separator-terminated prefix closes rooted and ../ traversal, but requiring filename == Path.GetFileName(filename) (stated) rejects subdirectory paths the original served; the 404 for missing files is a stated minor change.
